figurative_meaning_en: Monkey - a specific insult in formal or pure language

history: Referenced in the works of Kazi Nazrul Islam as a metaphorical expression for monkey-like behavior in a spiritual context.
note: This idiom uses a Sanskrit-derived term to euphemistically refer to a monkey as an insult, avoiding direct vulgarity.
